title: Introduction To Marketing
modules: Approaches To The Study Of Marketing
mcq: Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the key marketing mix variable around which all the other marketing mix variables revolve."
A product is the key marketing mix variable around which all the other marketing mix variables revolve.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the main target of consumer discontent with business."
Marketing is the main target of consumer discontent with business.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the statistical study of human population and its characteristics-in terms of distribution."
Demography is the statistical study of human population and its characteristics-in terms of distribution.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is an organised movement of citizens and government to strengthen the rights and power of buyers in relation to sellers."
Consumerism is an organised movement of citizens and government to strengthen the rights and power of buyers in relation to sellers.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ means of reaching their target markets."
Marketing practitioners should device means of reaching their target markets.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ are regarded as the pillar of any business activities."
Consumers or customers are regarded as the pillar of any business activities.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ are the most powerful element among marketing mix elements."
Channels of distribution are the most powerful element among marketing mix elements.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ are the most popular bases for segmenting customer groups."
Demographic factors are the most popular bases for segmenting customer groups.

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a person or group of persons or an organisation that purchases goods and services offered into the market in order to satisfy his/her needs."
A customer is a person or group of persons or an organisation that purchases goods and services offered into the market in order to satisfy his/her needs.

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ means dividing buyers into different groups based on social class, lifestyle, or personality; people in the same demographic groups can have different psychographic makeup."
Psychographic segmentation means dividing buyers into different groups based on social class, lifestyle, or personality; people in the same demographic groups can have different psychographic makeup.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the all-important link between a manufacturer and his customer."
Distribution is the all-important link between a manufacturer and his customer.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the newest of the five marketing management philosophies."
The societal marketing concept is the newest of the five marketing management philosophies.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ are those which are used by ultimate consumers or households and in such form that they can be used without further commercial processing."
Consumer goods are those which are used by ultimate consumers or households and in such form that they can be used without further commercial processing.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is an independent business concern that operates as a link between producers and ultimate consumers or industrial users."
A middleman is an independent business concern that operates as a link between producers and ultimate consumers or industrial users.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a routine affair in which the aroused need is satisfied, in the usual manner, by repurchasing the same brand."
Infrequent behaviour is a routine affair in which the aroused need is satisfied, in the usual manner, by repurchasing the same brand.

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is an interacting set of institutions, activities and flows designed to facilitate exchange transactions between an organisation and its markets."
A marketing system is an interacting set of institutions, activities and flows designed to facilitate exchange transactions between an organisation and its markets.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a very important element that must be critically studied and evaluated before undertaking any business."
Marketing environment is a very important element that must be critically studied and evaluated before undertaking any business.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is considered inevitable in modern business activities."
Promotion is considered inevitable in modern business activities.
